data.body: [P2] Preserve the latest trace when quiescence expires. This exception is raised after `latest_trace` is populated, so `validate_telemetry` exits through its `BackendError` handler before writing the normal `*-otel.json` failure artifact. Cases 21/24 can therefore lose the trace evidence needed to distinguish delayed confirmation from an export regression. Carry the latest trace on the timeout (or return a result containing both trace and timeout state), write it before reporting the timeout, and test this artifact path.
